rules.sd: sample SD across repeat means; null for fewer than two repeats
rules.failures: failed attempts score zero; not_run excluded and counted
rules.majority: strictly more than N/2 planned repeats; failed attempts cast empty page votes; majority pages are descriptive, not a new ranked method
rules.paired: match repeats within question, average, then existing 10000-resample paired question bootstrap and exact two-sided sign test vs Hybrid
rules.limitations: questions share targets; repeats do not add independent questions; fixed trees reused across repeats
